title: Shopping Assistant Streaming Components — Shared Definitions
description: Shared wire-format definitions for Shopping Assistant streaming components (quick replies, list message, CTA) across nexus-ai, flows, weni-webchat-socket, and webchat-service.

componentType.description: Component kind in scope for Shopping Assistant streaming (BD-009).

quickReplies.description: Ordered quick reply button labels displayed below the assistant bubble.

uuid.description: Unique identifier for the list item.

title.description: Item title shown in the list view and sent as shopper message on submit.

button_text.description: Label rendered on the list trigger button (e.g. 'Ver 9 ofertas' or 'Ver receitas').

item_count.description: Known item count surfaced to the shopper (FR-019, FR-038). Omitted when the count is unknown or not surfaced in the button label.

display_text.description: CTA button label (also used in screen-reader announcement; never the URL).

url.description: Complete absolute http(s) URL. Must never be emitted partially (BD-004, FR-018).

componentHintWire.description: Early component hint payload sent on gRPC and WebSocket. Must never carry a CTA URL (BD-004, Privacy).

labels.description: Optional button labels used to size skeleton placeholders without layout shift (FR-006, NFR-003). Omit when labels are not yet known.

count.description: Optional number of skeleton placeholders to reserve when labels are omitted. Defaults to labels.length when labels are present, otherwise 1.

item_count.description: Optional known item count for list_message (FR-019). Ignored for other component types.

componentsBundleWire.description: Authoritative final component payload(s) attached to a completed streamed response. Multiple component types may coexist (BD-006, FR-026).
